title: Unnamed zkSync Era vault 0x621425a1 = SyncSwap Vault (V1): protocol custody, E-U $0
closed_reasons: Contract is the documented SyncSwap Vault (V1); creation tx 0xecd787b7... block 9,764; owner 0x000002c3... (SyncSwap deployer EOA); no proxy, no delegatecall.
Deployed 30,944-byte EraVM runtime is byte-identical to published SyncSwapVault.sol compiled with zksolc 1.3.5 + solc 0.8.15 (optimizer on, 200 runs): 0 differing bytes.
Every withdraw/transfer entrypoint debits balances[token][msg.sender]; fresh caller reverts Panic 0x11.
transferAndDeposit pulls via safeTransferFrom(msg.sender) and credits the actual balance delta; no from parameter; unfunded caller reverts 0x7939f424.
Flash loans enforce postLoanBalance >= preLoanBalance + fee; a state-override receiver that does not repay reverts INVALID_POST_LOAN_BALANCE.
Owner has no sweep/withdraw function; only fee config, flash-loan pause and ownership transfer.
99.96% of the $5.59M custody is pool reserves attributable to LPs, not an unattributed pot.
key_facts: reserves(0x0) == native balance exactly (zero native excess); vault wETH balance 0; reserves(wETH)=0.
2,825 ERC-20 tokens checked: 40 have excess, all spam worth $0; no real-token excess.
All 3,821 SyncSwap V1 pools checked: one has 100 raw USDC excess ($0.0001); no dead pool holds a balance.
No EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon; no token approvals from the vault to router/master/fee recipient.
Live selectors: 24 + 0xffffffff sentinel, exact match to published ABI; no sweep/execute/delegatecall.
Blockscout metadata creation tx 0x72316d49... is a failed tx; the real deployment is the ContractDeployed event at block 9,764.
caveats: Read-only, point-in-time (2026-10-18). Foundry cannot fork EraVM, so the PoC is live eth_call/state-override, not a local fork.
The $5.59M is live AMM liquidity redeemable by LP holders (H-O), not a dormant pot.

Residual conditional surface: deposit(token,to) captures any pre-existing unattributed balance ($0.0001 standing); a 2-tx token.transfer(vault)+deposit pattern is front-runnable but not currently used.
If a real token ever shows balanceOf(vault) > reserves(token), deposit(token,me) is an immediate capture; re-check is cheap.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live: the $5.59M 'unnamed zkSync vault' is the documented SyncSwap V1 custody vault, 99.96% LP pool reserves, with byte-identical source, msg.sender-bound debits, delta-based deposits, repayment-enforced flash loans, and no owner sweep.
